page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, with the printed page number 78 at the top left.

main_text.p: quod in omen tractum, eventu fuit comprobatum. Licet autem nonnunquam tali omini respondeat effectus; numine divino, negotium ita dirigente: censerem tamen, nihil certi ex animantium brutorum commissionibus prædici posse, aut debere, nisi quis spiritum Propheticum se habere, certò comprobet.

Non itidem, uti alii volunt, ex eventu duellatorum, in confpectu exercitus utrinque dimicantium, quicquam de belli aleâ ominari licebit, nisi & hic nos certos reddat, vel divina quæ promissio, vel infallibilis prædictio. Olim tamen hoc à Germanis observari solitum fuisse, refert Annalium Scriptor; qui adeo ad talia omina attenti fuerunt, ut sæ-pissime ante prælium aut pu-gnam, cum quopiam ex hostium numero congrederen-tur,

page.notes: No marginal notes, no footnotes, no catchword and no signature. The dark spots and blots on the page (near the 78 and in the margins) are stains, not text. The faint marks at the bottom right corner are a scanner or digitiser artefact and were left out. "sæ-pissime" and "pu-gnam" are hyphenated at the line end as printed; the long s is transcribed as s.
